directAnswer: To take a screenshot on an iPhone, press the Side button and the Volume Up button simultaneously. For iPhones with a Home button, press the Home button and the Side button at the same time.
summary: Taking a screenshot on an iPhone is quick and easy, with different methods depending on the model.

sections.heading: Screenshot Methods by iPhone Model
sections.body: For iPhone models with Face ID, press the Side button and the Volume Up button. For iPhone models with a Home button, press the Home button and the Side button.

sections.heading: Accessing Your Screenshots
sections.body: Screenshots are saved to your Photos app in the 'Screenshots' album. You can also access them from the 'Recents' album.

sections.heading: Editing Your Screenshots
sections.body: After taking a screenshot, a thumbnail appears in the bottom left corner. Tap it to edit, annotate, or share immediately.

steps.title: For iPhones with Face ID
steps.detail: Press the Side button and the Volume Up button at the same time, then release them quickly.

steps.title: For iPhones with a Home button
steps.detail: Press the Home button and the Side button at the same time, then release them quickly.

steps.title: Accessing the Screenshot
steps.detail: Open the Photos app and navigate to the 'Screenshots' album to view your screenshot.

steps.title: Editing the Screenshot
steps.detail: Tap the thumbnail that appears after taking a screenshot to edit or share it.

faqs.question: Can I take a screenshot with AssistiveTouch?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can enable AssistiveTouch in Settings > Accessibility > Touch, then customize the menu to include a screenshot option.

faqs.question: Where are my screenshots stored?
faqs.answer: Screenshots are stored in the Photos app under the 'Screenshots' album.

faqs.question: How do I share a screenshot?
faqs.answer: After taking a screenshot, tap the thumbnail to open it, then use the share icon to send it via email, messages, or social media.

caveats: Ensure your device is updated, as the screenshot method may vary slightly with different iOS versions.
